aggregation.generalization_scope: one descriptive natural epimer contrast in one additional protein family
aggregation.interpretation: equal-anomer weighting is a computational heuristic; unknown solution populations, furanose and open-chain fractions are not estimated
aggregation.primary_aggregation: seed mean within anomer, then equal mean of two anomers per species
aggregation.sensitivity_scope: all site/state/calcium conditions remain separate; no pooled assay replicates

alignment.atom_selection: N/CA/C/O of exact chain, author residue number, residue identity matches in A/B
alignment.direction: holo center to independently solved native apo coordinate frame

assay.NB_semantics: No binding can be detected with glucose under the reported titration; categorical absence of detectable ITC binding, not a universal zero-affinity assertion or a numerical Kd lower bound.
assay.blank: each ligand titrated into buffer; dilution heats subtracted
assay.buffer_caveat: No NaCl is listed in the ITC recipe. Earlier gel filtration used 0.15 M NaCl; residual salt/dialysis exchange is not specified. Do not assert zero ionic strength or transfer 0.15 M into this assay by inference.
assay.presentation: free soluble reducing carbohydrates, no linker or multivalent glycan carrier
assay.protein_oligomer: disulfide-linked homodimer; two sites per protein monomer
assay.ten_mM_is: syringe/titrant concentration, not stated terminal concentration in the protein cell

information_regime: true-site-local; ligand-informed prior sites; not blind
limitations: One natural epimer contrast in one additional protein family; no precision or reliability certification.
No AUROC/AUPRC is estimated from one pair and no score-to-dissociation calibration is performed.
Glucose NB is absence of detectable binding in the source ITC titration, not a numerical Kd bound.
Four model states represent two free-sugar species; equal anomer weighting is a heuristic and solution populations/furanose/open-chain fractions are unknown.
Known-site boxes use prior melibiose structural information; no blind-site claim follows.
Native glycosylated apo versus recombinant holo is a disclosed construct/context approximation; removed covalent glycans and Ser218 alternate selection are recorded.
Fixed +2 Vina calcium is not an assay-validated model of coordination or polarization; both profiles omit explicit waters.
Generated input conformers provide chemical identity only; no experimental pose truth or RMSD endpoint is available.
Exact assay-batch sequence, residual assay salt, ITC detection threshold and source Table SIII uncertainties remain unresolved.

alternate_conformers.rule: one whole residue conformer by highest mean occupancy; lexical tie break
one whole residue conformer by highest mean occupancy; lexical tie break

apo.apo_context_caveat: native glycosylated apo protein; covalent glycans removed explicitly
